utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm spreading the word about the repair drive now, so we should get a nice turnout. If you hear of anyone who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—I’m still catching up, so extra tape, a screwdriver, or any spare nails would really help. I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll keep an eye out for extra tape, a screwdriver, and spare nails, and I’ll send anyone who needs help your way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple and meet at the corner lot before heading to the repair shop. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m just hearing updates second-hand, so what time works best for everyone? I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make it 10 a.m. at the corner lot — that should keep things simple. Please pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 still works for me—I can coordinate around the school schedule. If that’s good for you, we can start sorting the donations then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm — Saturday at 9 works for me too. And Leo, are you covering anything for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate the school side, and I’ll check on Leo’s piece too. Let’s plan to start sorting the donations at 9.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still moving along nicely, and I’ll keep an ear out too. If I hear anyone who needs help, I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, spare nails, and I’m checking for a screwdriver too. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that should cover a lot. I’ll let you know if I hear of anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good, but do we have the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded? I just want to make sure the repair drive stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll ask folks to share any broken items and any repair skills they’ve got, and I’ll keep nudging people so we’ve got a clear count and pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Just let me know the pickup time as soon as you have it, and I’ll keep an eye on the count from here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s already looking pretty busy over there, Hana. If you’d like, I can check back later and let you know what folks are bringing by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. Could you check back later and tell me what needs fixing so I can be ready?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll check back later and let you know what needs fixing so you can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re meeting at my place at 3, then heading over together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right—3 at your place, then we head over together. I’ll do my best not to forget this time!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — just be on time, and we’ll head out together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The leaky faucet, loose porch step, and broken fence latch are the main ones—thanks. Just tell me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I’ll get the time and place to you right away. We’ve got the tools covered, so you can just show up ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep tracking the repair drive location and let you know if it changes. If you’ve got the drop-off spot, send it my way and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can share the drop-off spot, just send me the details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send me the drop-off spot when you have it, and I’ll keep it noted in case it changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, Rosa’s got both covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — just let folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. If they have broken items or repair skills, bring them along!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got the update — Sunday at the community center, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — I’ll quietly pass it along to a few neighbors. If I hear anyone mention a drop-off spot, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate that. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is still picking up nicely—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Let me know if you hear anything, and I’ll keep the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus—I’ll keep my ear out and pass along anything useful. Hope the tools get plenty of good use!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring the wrench set, screwdriver, gloves, and hammer for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ll keep nudging folks about the repair drive and remind them to share any broken items or repair skills they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll head over soon with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can quietly spread the word around the block if that would help. If you hear where the drop-off spot is, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll check where the drop-off spot is and let you know. Could you also keep an ear out for what items need fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about items needing fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday around 9 still works for me. I can help with the repair drive then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — Saturday around 9 works for me too. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I’ll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be at the corner lot and ready to help load everything up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m on my way and should be a little late as usual. I’ll meet you at the corner lot and help load up what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — I’ll be at the corner lot and ready to help when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help spread the word about the repair drive. Just let me know what details you want shared.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. Are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word, but I’m not covering a specific item myself—just tell me what details you want shared.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me a quick heads-up if the repair drive moves, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive spot and I’ll let you know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — appreciate it. I’ll watch for your update and head to the spot you send.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s looking like a pretty good turnout already, Nell. If you want, I can let you know later what folks are bringing by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — please do. I’m happy to help if they still need anything, and I can spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Nell — I’ll keep you posted on what comes in, and if I hear they still need anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — we’re meeting at the community shed at 3. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that still works for me—I’ll be there at 3. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—see you at the community shed at 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anyone reaches out for help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Quinn—thanks for spreading the word. If I hear of any broken bits or handy fixers, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren—appreciate it. I’ll keep asking around and send anyone with repair needs your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — we could use extra hands and maybe a table or two at the community center on Sunday. I’ll send the full update out so everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 still works for me. I can help coordinate around the school schedule if that’s still a good time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me. I’ll meet you at the corner lot and we can head out from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll meet you at the corner lot at 9. Thanks, Eli—I’ll work around the school schedule and see you then.
